name: Island (run, jump, collect)
pitch: A little round creature runs and jumps around a floating island, gathering sparks while stones roll past.
controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to jump, Q/E or drag to turn the camera. Gamepad and touch work.
use_when: a 3D game where you see your character from behind: collecting, exploring a small place, a 3D platformer, an adventure, anything with a character that runs and jumps. Also the right pick when no other starter fits.
already_good: Jump with coyote time, buffering, variable height and faster falling
A follow camera that never clips through the island
Hazards you can read before they move (worn tracks, a wobble)
Pickups with a freeze-frame and a rising chime
An end card that says why you lost and what to try
